description: This file defines the CameraCaptureManager class, which manages camera operations such as listing devices, taking photos, and recording videos within an Android application. It utilizes Android's CameraX library along with other Android APIs to handle camera permissions, device selection, image capture with EXIF data, and video recording with audio options.

classes.name: CameraCaptureManager
classes.description: Manages camera operations including listing devices, capturing photos, and recording videos within an Android app. Handles permissions, device selection, image processing, and video recording lifecycle.

methods.name: attachLifecycleOwner
methods.description: Attaches a LifecycleOwner to manage camera lifecycle.

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Attaches a PermissionRequester for handling runtime permission requests.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists available camera devices with their info.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo based on specified parameters, returning the image data and orientation.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a short video clip with specified parameters and returns file info.

methods.name: rotateBitmapByExif
methods.description: Rotates a bitmap according to EXIF orientation data.

methods.name: parseFacing
methods.description: Parses and validates the camera facing direction parameter.

methods.name: parseQuality
methods.description: Parses the quality parameter from JSON.

methods.name: parseMaxWidth
methods.description: Parses maximum width for scaling images.

methods.name: parseDurationMs
methods.description: Parses duration in milliseconds from parameters.

methods.name: parseIncludeAudio
methods.description: Checks if audio should be included in video recording.

methods.name: resolveCameraSelector
methods.description: Resolves which camera device to use based on device ID or facing direction.

methods.name: cameraDeviceInfoOrNull
methods.description: Extracts camera info for a device, including ID, name, position, and type.

methods.name: cameraIdOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves the camera ID as a string from CameraInfo.

methods.name: takeJpegWithExif
methods.description: Captures a JPEG image and retrieves its EXIF orientation info.
